traced_to_an_existing_group.caveat: All six are Set D v3 paraphrase variants whose declared cell-mate is already in the categorisation. But the three group_ids they would attach to (store_g025, store_g028, store_g029) DO NOT CORRESPOND TO CELLS OF THE DECLARED DESIGN. Each was built by one-token pair detection over the store, and each pairs a variant of one verb cell with a variant of a DIFFERENT verb cell, because the two strings happen to differ by one token. store_g025 = {hit desire-committed v0, punch desire-committed v0}. store_g028 = {shoot act-committed v0, kill act-committed v1}. store_g029 = {shoot desire-committed v0, kill desire-committed v1}. The correct move is to split each along the declaration and attach the orphan to its own cell, not to append the orphan to the existing group. Appending would enlarge a cross-cell artifact and make it look like a designed triple.
traced_to_an_existing_group.also_note: No orphan is the missing member of a correctly-formed existing group. That is not luck: the store-side pair detector already caught every case where both members of a one-token pair were in the store together, so what it left behind are pairs where it could not see the relation at all - either because the members differ by more than one token, or because both members were unmapped.

groups_that_become_complete_if_the_orpha.note: COMPLETE = every member of the declared pair/cell is present in the categorisation once the orphan is keyed. Groups whose declared members were never scored are excluded, since a group cannot be completed by a row that does not exist.

the_headline.half_declared_design: The clearest structural finding. The Set D 2x2 (frame x commitment x person x tense x embedding) is HALF-DECLARED. Four of its arms are already in the file as SETD ladders - angry_want (desire/uncommitted/3rd/past), i_angry_want (1st/present), told_want (reported_desire), whisper_want (quoted_desire) - and every other cell of the same design is unmapped. Any statistic stratified on source=SETD is therefore running on the desire-uncommitted arm alone while believing it has the design. That is exactly the failure the finding field was created to prevent.
